cards.ex: The new vaccine is a breakthrough discovery in the fight against the disease.
cards.exUz: Yangi vaksina kasallikka qarshi kurashda katta kashfiyotdir.
cards.uzDef: Ilmda birdan katta muvaffaqiyatga erishish, yangi narsa topish.

cards.ex: I couldn't figure out how the machine worked, so I asked for help.
cards.exUz: Men mashina qanday ishlashini tushunmadim, shuning uchun yordam so'radim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunishga harakat qilib, oxirida tushunib yetmoq.

cards.ex: The university is known for its cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence.
cards.exUz: Universitet sun'iy intellekt sohasidagi zamonaviy tadqiqotlari bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Eng yangi va ilg'or texnologiyalar yordamida olib borilayotgan tadqiqot.

cards.ex: Scientists are constantly pushing the boundaries of what we know about space.
cards.exUz: Olimlar doimo kosmos haqidagi bilimlarimiz chegaralarini kengaytirishga harakat qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada mavjud bilimlarni kengaytirishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Her groundbreaking study on climate change won her a Nobel Prize.
cards.exUz: Uning iqlim o'zgarishi bo'yicha tub burilish yasagan tadqiqoti unga Nobel mukofotini keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada katta o'zgarishlarga olib keladigan muhim tadqiqot.

cards.ex: Learning to code is often a process of trial and error.
cards.exUz: Dasturlashni o'rganish ko'pincha sinov va xato jarayonidir.
cards.uzDef: Xatolardan saboq olib, to'g'ri natijaga erishish usuli.

cards.ex: The documentary shed light on the causes of poverty in the region.
cards.exUz: Hujjatli film mintaqadagi qashshoqlik sabablarini yoritib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunarliroq qilish, yangi ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: The new lab is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment.
cards.exUz: Yangi laboratoriya eng zamonaviy uskunalar bilan jihozlangan.
cards.uzDef: Eng so'nggi texnologiyalar bilan jihozlangan yoki yaratilgan.

cards.ex: They have a new scientific project in the works.
cards.exUz: Ularning ustida ish olib borilayotgan yangi ilmiy loyihasi bor.
cards.uzDef: Hali tugallanmagan, lekin ustida ish olib borilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so we have to go back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz boshidan boshlashimiz kerak.
cards.term: go back to the drawing board
cards.uzDef: Reja ish bermaganda, yangi reja tuzish uchun qayta boshlash.

cards.ex: Scientists are trying to unravel the mystery of dark matter.
cards.exUz: Olimlar qorong'u materiya sirini ochishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab muammoni yoki sirni hal qilish, tushunish.

cards.ex: This discovery will pave the way for new treatments.
cards.exUz: Bu kashfiyot yangi davolash usullariga yo'l ochadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda biror narsaning rivojlanishiga imkon yaratmoq.

cards.ex: To solve this problem, we need to think outside the box.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, standart usullardan farqli, yangicha yondashuv bilan o'ylash.

cards.ex: He put forward a theory about the origins of the universe.
cards.exUz: U olamning kelib chiqishi haqida nazariyani ilgari surdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi nazariyani taklif qilmoq, uni muhokama qilish uchun ommaga taqdim etmoq.

cards.ex: The new research will build on previous studies in the field.
cards.exUz: Yangi tadqiqot bu sohadagi oldingi tadqiqotlarni rivojlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud narsani yanada yaxshilash, kengaytirish, rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: The new technology represents a major leap forward in medical treatment.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiya tibbiy davolashda katta qadamni anglatadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada katta yutuqqa erishish, taraqqiyotga erishish.

cards.ex: The data suggests that the climate is changing rapidly.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumotlar iqlimning tez o'zgarayotganini ko'rsatadi.
cards.uzDef: Yig'ilgan ma'lumotlar asosida shunday xulosaga kelish mumkinligi.

cards.ex: The evidence points to him being the one who committed the crime.
cards.exUz: Dalillar uning jinoyat sodir etgan shaxs ekanligini ko'rsatmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud dalillar biror narsaning rostligini yoki sodir bo'lganligini ko'rsatadi.

cards.ex: The initial findings of the study are promising.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqotning dastlabki xulosalari umid beruvchi.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqot boshida olingan va hali to'liq tasdiqlanmagan natijalar.

cards.ex: The scientific community is debating the new findings.
cards.exUz: Ilmiy jamoatchilik yangi xulosalarni muhokama qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ilm bilan shug'ullanadigan odamlar guruhi (olimlar, tadqiqotchilar).

cards.ex: The team is carrying out research on cancer treatment.
cards.exUz: Jamoa saraton kasalligini davolash bo'yicha tadqiqotlar o'tkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ilmiy tadqiqotni amalga oshirish, tadqiqot ishlarini olib borish.

cards.ex: The experiment confirmed the hypothesis.
cards.exUz: Tajriba farazni tasdiqladi.
cards.uzDef: Gipotezani tajriba yoki dalillar yordamida to'g'ri ekanligini isbotlash.

cards.ex: New evidence disproved the long-held theory.
cards.exUz: Yangi dalillar uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan nazariyani rad etdi.
cards.uzDef: Nazariyani tajriba yoki dalillar yordamida noto'g'ri ekanligini isbotlash.

cards.ex: She is a leading expert in the field of genetics.
cards.exUz: U genetika sohasida yetakchi mutaxassis.
cards.uzDef: O'z sohasida eng yaxshi, eng tajribali mutaxassis.

cards.ex: We need to consider the ethical considerations of this research.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu tadqiqotning axloqiy mulohazalarini ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ilmiy ishlar paytida axloqiy me'yorlarga rioya qilish zarurligi.

cards.ex: Good scientists always question the assumptions.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi olimlar doimo taxminlarni so'roq ostiga olishadi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy deb qabul qilingan fikrlarning to'g'riligiga shubha bilan qarash.

cards.ex: The students made observations about plant growth.
cards.exUz: Talabalar o'simliklarning o'sishi haqida kuzatuvlar olib borishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani diqqat bilan kuzatib, ma'lumot yig'ish.

cards.ex: The study was published in a peer-reviewed journal.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot ilmiy jurnalda chop etildi.
cards.uzDef: Ilmiy maqolalar chop etiladigan va mutaxassislar tomonidan tekshiriladigan jurnal.

cards.ex: The science museum is designed to spark interest in science.
cards.exUz: Ilm-fan muzeyi fanga qiziqish uyg'otish uchun mo'ljallangan.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qiziqish paydo qilish, rag'batlantirish.

cards.ex: Scientists are working to tackle the problem of climate change.
cards.exUz: Olimlar iqlim o'zgarishi muammosiga yechim topish uchun ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin muammoni hal qilishga harakat qilish, uni yechish yo'lini topish.
